extraction.title: I&E Lecture Notes Fall
key_claims: Innovation is about finding problems worth solving and turning them into opportunities.
Entrepreneurship is about purposeful, systematic innovation and begins with the hunt for opportunities.
extraction.cohort_context: Cohort-2024, introductory lecture on innovation and entrepreneurship, setting the theoretical framework for the course.

Method 2: Scenario Analysis
The second technique for re-imagining the future is what is called scenario analysis
This is where we create four alternative futures – think of them as stories or science fiction
The key is to figure out what the axes are
There is no formula or rule here – whatever seems to work
And once you have your boxes, they can then be analyzed for what products and services will be needed in that future
Scenario Analysis: E-Commerce
These were the two axes chosen by my colleague Sascha
He then created stories in the four boxes, accompanied by pictures
CHANGE SLIDE
And then he filled out the stories
Each represents an alternative future that presents different challenges, uncertainties, and problems; and thus opportunities
Scenarios give you a chance to ask
How will life be different in such a future?
How will people live and what new products and services will they need?
